items.name: Fleet Optimization Program newbuild LR1 tankers
items.claim: International Seaways contracted four additional LR1 product tanker newbuildings for a combined $244 million, deliveries expected in 2028, adding to two remaining LR1s from its original six-vessel program due Q3 2026.
items.source_excerpt: Fleet Optimization Program: Contracted four additional LR1 newbuildings for an aggregate price of $244 million, with deliveries expected in 2028. Remaining two LR1 newbuildings from the original six-vessel program expected to deliver in the third quarter of 2026.

notes: Q2 2026 results release names the Fleet Optimization Program newbuild orders; no separate disclosed backlog or RPO figure found.
